# FreeType 2.15.0

Upstream: https://github.com/freetype/freetype/tree/VER-2-15-0

Source archive SHA-256: `87c7f1f8699b91e89f773f7dcfa505b044e1dae67f62a55d4e29c3afdcac4fb8`

Built with its bundled zlib; optional external compression and shaping libraries are disabled.
The Emscripten build enables the compiler's Emscripten setjmp/longjmp lowering.

Retained files are upstream sources, public headers, and license notices.
Platform projects, dependency bundles, examples, and tests are omitted.
